name: Overboard dump valves and ESD-initiated isolation of all wells and pipelines
description: Emergency shutdown (ESD) systems that isolate wells and pipelines, using surface safety valves (SSV), boarding shutdown valves (BSDV), subsurface safety valves (SSSV) and shutdown valves; plus overboard dump valves used on offshore water injection / drain systems. Evidence is primarily from BSEE regulation, API RP 14C definitions (search extract), API 6A (search extract), OEM datasheets and an incident-derived engineering article.
aliases: Overboard dump valves and ESD-initiated isolation of all wells and pipelines
